## Summary

Explain why this change is needed and link the issue. Use `Closes #...` only when the whole issue will be complete after this merge.

## Evidence

Show the before/after difference and commands or CI links that prove it. For UI changes, include screenshots; for data changes, include provenance, coverage, exclusions and visual comparisons. State what remains unverified.

## Merge Danger

Describe deployment, compatibility or data risks and the rollback. Agents must follow the `pr` skill and verify the final description against the current diff and checks.
